trophies.guide: The platinum pops automatically once the other 54 trophies are earned. There is no separate task: work the roadmap in order, finish the 100% completion checklist last, and this unlocks with it. PowerPyx rates the whole platinum 4/10 at roughly 200 hours, all offline, in a single playthrough. Sources: PowerPyx trophy roadmap; Exophase official list.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. It unlocks when you finish the opening mission Gone Fishing in Chapter 1. Just play the story; no side requirement. Sources: PowerPyx trophy roadmap; Exophase official list.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.checkBefore: Finish the Chapter 1 meditation for Positive Mental Attitude before this chapter ends.
trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. It unlocks when Chapter 1 ends, after the first mission of Chapter 2. Before you leave Chapter 1, do the one meditation spot at Jason's house (see Positive Mental Attitude) — that is the only thing in the chapter that can be missed. Sources: PowerPyx trophy roadmap; KeenGamer trophy guide.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. It unlocks when you finish Chapter 2. Keep playing the main missions; the last meditation spot only becomes available once you can play as both characters, after the Coffee Break mission in this chapter. Sources: PowerPyx trophy roadmap; Exophase official list.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. It unlocks when you finish Chapter 3. There are five chapters in total and no mission replay, so save manually at the start of each chapter as a safety net. Sources: PowerPyx trophy roadmap; Exophase official list.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. It unlocks when you finish Chapter 4. One chapter remains after this; use the lull before the finale to clear any optional missions still open, since missions cannot be replayed. Sources: PowerPyx trophy roadmap; Exophase official list.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.checkBefore: Finish optional missions and the Chapter 1 meditation before the finale — there is no mission replay.
trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. It unlocks when you finish the final mission of Chapter 5. After the credits you return to free-roam and the 100% completion checklist unlocks, so the finale is a gateway, not an ending — but check the 'do before advancing' list first, because missions cannot be replayed. Sources: PowerPyx trophy roadmap; KeenGamer trophy guide.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. It unlocks when you finish the mission Breakfast Run. The mission name is the only requirement — complete it as part of the story. Sources: PowerPyx trophy roadmap; Exophase official list.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. It unlocks when you finish the mission The Cartel Heist. Heist missions are story beats, so this comes naturally while playing through the chapters. Sources: PowerPyx trophy roadmap; Exophase official list.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. It unlocks when you finish the mission Child's Play. Play the story missions in order and it pops on its own. Sources: PowerPyx trophy roadmap; Exophase official list.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. It unlocks when you finish the mission Headliners. No extra objective is needed beyond completing the mission itself. Sources: PowerPyx trophy roadmap; Exophase official list.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. It unlocks when you finish the mission VCIA Takedown. VCIA is the Vice City airport area; the mission itself is the requirement. Sources: PowerPyx trophy roadmap; Exophase official list.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. It unlocks when you finish the mission Operation Savage Glory. Complete it as part of the story; nothing else is required. Sources: PowerPyx trophy roadmap; Exophase official list.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.checkBefore: Check the 100% checklist before the finale — progress made during the story already counts.
trophies.guide: The longest trophy and the hardest, per PowerPyx. After the story, open Progress > Stats > 100% Completion to see the checklist. It is lenient — closer to 60% true completion: about 200 of 277 vehicles, 100 of 255 animals, 50 of 66 weapons, 70 of 80 challenges, all required robberies, shooting-range golds and drone races. Progress made during the story already counts, so scan vehicles and study animals as you play. Sources: PowerPyx trophy roadmap; KeenGamer trophy guide.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Stunts are jumps, near-misses and trick driving counted across free-roam. Rack them up naturally while driving between missions, then grind the remainder after the story by chaining jumps and stunts in open areas. The count is cumulative and never resets. Sources: PowerPyx trophy roadmap; PSNProfiles trophy list.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Sample one of every activity the game offers — racing, fishing, arcade games, bowling, the shooting range, drone races and the rest — once each. Do it early: it also teaches you which activities you enjoy grinding later, and it counts toward other trophies such as Stick Fiddler and Top Fun. The exact activity roster is not independently confirmed yet, so try every activity marker you find. Sources: PowerPyx trophy roadmap; Exophase official list.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: There are 42 Shooting Range challenges and every one needs a gold medal. PowerPyx notes the golds are not too difficult. Work through the ranges during the story to spread the effort, and return after the story for any golds still missing. These golds are also part of the 100% completion checklist. Sources: PowerPyx trophy roadmap; PSNProfiles trophy list.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Top Fun drone races run at several locations across Leonida; win at least one race at every location. Learn each course with a practice run, then race to win. Drone race wins are also required by the 100% completion checklist, so this is not optional for the platinum. Sources: PowerPyx trophy roadmap; PSNProfiles trophy list.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 races, each at a different race — repeats of the same race do not count. Mix race types and locations; race wins also feed the 100% checklist, so keep racing until both this and the checklist are done. Sources: PowerPyx trophy roadmap; Exophase official list.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Find Cal and take him on in a fishing challenge, then out-fish him. Fishing is one of the game's activities; play a few casual rounds first to learn the casting and reeling timing before challenging him. Sources: PowerPyx trophy roadmap; Exophase official list.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Walk into an arcade and finish one full arcade game. Any arcade game counts. This is one of the quickest trophies — do it early while exploring Vice City. Sources: PowerPyx trophy roadmap; Exophase official list.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Andy is a Lucia-only quest giver. Play through his whole mission strand as Lucia until his final mission completes. KeenGamer notes every quest giver tied to a trophy returns after the story, so this cannot be locked out — but do his missions as they appear so the strand stays fresh. Sources: KeenGamer trophy guide; PowerPyx trophy roadmap.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Play through Kenton's whole mission strand until his final mission completes. Kenton's strand is part of the stranger and contact missions; answer his calls and follow his markers as they appear during and after the story. Sources: PowerPyx trophy roadmap; Exophase official list.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Play through Billy's whole mission strand until his final mission completes. Like the other contact strands, his missions appear as markers and calls — take them when they show up rather than leaving them all for the end. Sources: PowerPyx trophy roadmap; Exophase official list.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.checkBefore: Stranger strands with an hourglass icon expire — take them when they appear; the ones that count for trophies are still available after the story.
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Strangers & Freaks strands are the side missions marked for strangers across Leonida. Complete 8 full strands — the contact strands for Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone count toward this, plus Bret's hunting strand. KeenGamer notes quests with an hourglass expire, though the ones that count for trophies remain available after the story. Sources: KeenGamer trophy guide; PowerPyx trophy roadmap.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Play through Randy's whole mission strand until his final mission completes. Take his missions as they appear; the strand counts toward the 8 Strangers & Freaks strands as well. Sources: PowerPyx trophy roadmap; Exophase official list.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Tyrone is a Jason-only quest giver. Play through his whole mission strand as Jason until his final mission completes. Switch characters regularly so Jason-only strands do not stall while you play as Lucia. Sources: KeenGamer trophy guide; PowerPyx trophy roadmap.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: THE ONLY MISSABLE TROPHY. PowerPyx and GTABase agree: the first meditation is missable. After the mission Down to Earth in Chapter 1, Lucia is at Jason's house in the morning and mentions meditating — follow her to the balcony and accept. Do it before Chapter 1 ends. The last meditation only unlocks once you can play as both characters, after Coffee Break in Chapter 2. Meditate at every spot across Leonida; the remaining spots are available in free-roam. Sources: PowerPyx trophy roadmap; KeenGamer trophy guide (GTABase agrees it is missable).
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Bret is a Jason-only quest giver who sends you hunting. Take his strand, track the unique animal he names, and bring it down. Hunting uses the tracking and shooting tools the game teaches in Bret's early missions; the strand also counts toward the 8 Strangers & Freaks strands. Sources: KeenGamer trophy guide; PowerPyx trophy roadmap.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Collectible cards are scattered across Leonida in sets; complete any 3 full sets. Cards are a partial requirement of the 100% checklist too (PowerPyx lists 15 complete card sets among the checklist's collectibles), so keep collecting beyond 3 sets. Note each card's location as you find it — there is no in-game card tracker shortcut. Sources: PowerPyx trophy roadmap; KeenGamer trophy guide.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: WAiNK It is a photo or check-in style collectible at 100 spots across Leonida. The 100% checklist also wants 100 WAiNK locations, so this trophy and the checklist finish together. Work through the map region by region in free-roam so you do not re-cover ground. Sources: PowerPyx trophy roadmap; KeenGamer trophy guide.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: The game has 80 challenges in eight groups of ten. Complete any 50 — you do not need the hardest ones. The 100% checklist wants 70 of 80, so keep going past 50 toward 70. Pick the easy groups first (driving, shooting, exploration) and leave the hardest challenges for last. Sources: PowerPyx trophy roadmap; PSNProfiles trophy list.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, raise a 4-star wanted level, then lose the cops and escape. Use a fast car, break line of sight, and hide until the wanted level clears — the trophy pops when you escape with your partner. Do it in open country where you can outrun the search. Sources: PowerPyx trophy roadmap; Exophase official list.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob three shops in a row without the wanted level dropping between robberies — keep the heat on the whole run. Plan a route with three close shops, rob fast, and drive straight to the next. If the wanted level clears, the chain breaks and you start over. Sources: PowerPyx trophy roadmap; Exophase official list.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Discover — scan or encounter — 100 vehicles across Leonida. The 100% checklist wants 200 of 277 base-model vehicles, so this is the halfway mark on a longer grind. Scan every new vehicle you see during the story and the count builds on its own. Sources: PowerPyx trophy roadmap; PSNProfiles trophy list.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Combat Focus is the slow-aim ability. Trigger it in a busy firefight and drop five enemies before it ends. Pick a fight with plenty of enemies — a gang operation or a wanted-level shootout — and aim for headshots while time is slowed. Sources: PowerPyx trophy roadmap; Exophase official list.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: VCIA is the Vice City airport. Make an unscheduled departure — take a plane and leave without following the normal departure routine. Steal a plane on the runway and take off; the trophy pops once you are airborne and clear. Sources: PowerPyx trophy roadmap; Exophase official list.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: The Rhino is the game's tank. Get into one and survive the heat it draws — the description is a joke about riding a tank while wanted. Steal or find a Rhino, then drive it through a wanted-level chase until the trophy pops. The exact trigger is not independently confirmed yet. Sources: PowerPyx trophy roadmap; Exophase official list.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store clean — no alarms, no detection. Go in quiet, move fast, take the goods and leave before anyone spots you. A stealth approach and a quick getaway car are the whole method. Sources: PowerPyx trophy roadmap; Exophase official list.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Rob five bank vaults and escape after each one. Bank jobs are part of the 100% checklist (PowerPyx lists 22 bank jobs and 8 bank vault robberies among its requirements), so work through them as a set in free-roam. Escape cleanly each time — the count only rises on a successful getaway. Sources: PowerPyx trophy roadmap; KeenGamer trophy guide.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Find an armored truck on the road, stop it, take its cargo and escape the wanted level it draws. Trucks run set routes — watch for one, block it, crack it open and get clear before the cops close in. Sources: PowerPyx trophy roadmap; Exophase official list.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Visit every region of the state of Leonida — Vice City, the beaches, the swamps, the keys and the countryside. Drive or fly the map edge to edge; the trophy pops when the last unexplored region is covered. Do it gradually during the story so free-roam cleanup is shorter. Sources: PowerPyx trophy roadmap; Exophase official list.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Each gang in Leonida runs illegal operations. Rob one operation per gang, covering every gang. Gang operations are also part of the 100% checklist (PowerPyx lists 39 gang operations), so this trophy and the checklist finish together. Sources: PowerPyx trophy roadmap; KeenGamer trophy guide.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Go to Ocean Beach, find a spot with a view — a beach bar or terrace — and enjoy a cocktail there. This is a quiet moment trophy: no combat, no timer. Do it early while you are in Vice City; the exact venue is not independently confirmed yet, so look for a beachfront bar on Ocean Beach. Sources: PowerPyx trophy roadmap; Exophase official list.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Drive a vehicle through a showroom's glass front and out the other side, in the classic style the description hints at. Pick a showroom, build speed on the street outside, and smash straight through. The exact showroom is not independently confirmed yet. Sources: PowerPyx trophy roadmap; Exophase official list.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Go to the Kolt & Associates bowling alley and follow through — bowl a full game there. Bowling is one of the game's activities, and a visit here is all this trophy asks. The exact trigger is not independently confirmed yet. Sources: PowerPyx trophy roadmap; Exophase official list.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

trophies.checkBefore: This trophy's description hints at a story choice. There is no mission replay, so check the roadmap's choice note before advancing past story decisions.
trophies.guide: The official description is deliberately vague, and no published guide has pinned down the exact steps yet — not independently confirmed. What is known: it is a story-adjacent trophy tied to a partnership, so play the story, take the partnership opportunities as they come, and it should unlock in the course of a normal playthrough. Sources: Exophase official list; PSNProfiles trophy list.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.checkBefore: This trophy's description hints at a story choice. There is no mission replay, so check the roadmap's choice note before advancing past story decisions.
trophies.guide: The official description is deliberately vague, and no published guide has pinned down the exact steps yet — not independently confirmed. What is known: it is tied to a choice made during the story, so it should unlock as you make story decisions. Keep manual saves at chapter starts so a choice can be revisited if needed. Sources: Exophase official list; PSNProfiles trophy list.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.checkBefore: This trophy's description hints at a second attempt. There is no mission replay, so keep manual saves at chapter starts.
trophies.guide: The official description is deliberately vague, and no published guide has pinned down the exact steps yet — not independently confirmed. The name suggests succeeding on a second attempt at something — retry a failed activity or mission beat and it may pop. Keep manual saves so a retry is always possible. Sources: Exophase official list; PSNProfiles trophy list.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.checkBefore: This trophy's description hints at a story surprise. There is no mission replay, so keep manual saves at chapter starts.
trophies.guide: The official description is deliberately vague, and no published guide has pinned down the exact steps yet — not independently confirmed. The name suggests a surprise story moment — play the story and let it happen; it is very likely a story beat that unlocks on its own. Sources: Exophase official list; PSNProfiles trophy list.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: A melee drive-by means attacking from a moving vehicle with a melee weapon. Drive past a group of pedestrians or enemies and swing — bowling them over is the joke in the name. Find a crowded street, keep your speed low, and strike as you pass. Sources: PowerPyx trophy roadmap; Exophase official list.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Marked Bills are dirty money that must be laundered through your contacts. Keep laundering as you earn — $250,000 in total, cumulative across the whole playthrough. Use contacts as they unlock and launder regularly rather than letting bills pile up. Sources: PowerPyx trophy roadmap; Exophase official list.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 in total across all shops — weapons, clothes, vehicles, anything sold in a shop. It is cumulative and comes naturally if you buy gear as you play; if you are short at the end, buy expensive vehicles or weapons to close the gap. Sources: PowerPyx trophy roadmap; Exophase official list.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Buy every garage property available for purchase across Leonida. Garages cost money, so save up — this pairs with the spending and laundering trophies. Check the property listings as new areas open and buy each garage when you can afford it. Sources: PowerPyx trophy roadmap; Exophase official list.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Use the Scooter Bros app on the in-game phone to register vehicles — 10 in total. Register every vehicle you drive regularly; the app is the in-game system for claiming vehicles as yours. Sources: PowerPyx trophy roadmap; Exophase official list.
trophies.name: On the Spot
